description: Vehicle 1 goes straight through an intersection. Vehicle 2 approaches from the perpendicular road to the right of Vehicle 1’s approach and turns right onto Vehicle 1’s exit road. Vehicle 3 is traveling in the same direction as Vehicle 1 and starts behind Vehicle 1 in an adjacent lane; Vehicle 3 changes lanes into Vehicle 1’s lane on the exit road. Near the merge region on the exit road, a parked car partially blocks the right edge of Vehicle 1’s lane. A bicyclist travels in the adjacent lane on the exit road in the same direction as Vehicle 1, starting shortly after the intersection.
